# mobile-ci

> Composite GitHub Actions and reusable `workflow_call` workflows for
> fleet-native React Native / Expo (and pure Swift / Xcode) mobile CI on
> self-hosted runners: Maestro e2e without a native compile per pull request,
> warm-up, store screenshots, development and store releases, and OTA updates
> (EAS-free GitHub Release previews or EAS Update).

Pin `@v4.5.0 # v4.5.0` (or a full commit SHA); `v4` floats on the current
major. The test pipelines need no secrets. Every calling job needs a
`permissions:` block granting what the called workflow's jobs request — see
docs/examples/README.md. Start from the complete, CI-checked examples, then read
`docs/workflows/<name>.md` for every workflow you wire.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Canonical instructions for AI agents: conventions for changing this repo, and for consumers the workflow list, required permissions, OTA backend rules, secrets and pinning.
- [README.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/README.md): Overview, decision guide ("which workflow do I need?"), what changed in v4.x, action and workflow catalogs.
- [docs/examples/README.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/README.md): Index of complete caller workflows and a permissions-at-a-glance table.

## Examples

- [docs/examples/public-expo-app/e2e.yml](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/public-expo-app/e2e.yml): Public Expo app: iOS + Android Maestro e2e on the repack path.
- [docs/examples/public-expo-app/warm-up.yml](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/public-expo-app/warm-up.yml): Public Expo app: the warm-up that publishes the base binaries pull requests repack.
- [docs/examples/public-expo-app/ota-preview.yml](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/public-expo-app/ota-preview.yml): Public Expo app: tokenless GitHub Release OTA preview.
- [docs/examples/public-expo-app/pr-closed.yml](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/public-expo-app/pr-closed.yml): Public Expo app: PR-closed cleanup and the scheduled preview sweep.
- [docs/examples/private-multi-brand-expo-app/ota-preview.yml](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/private-multi-brand-expo-app/ota-preview.yml): Private Expo app: EAS Update preview on a per-PR channel.
- [docs/examples/private-multi-brand-expo-app/dev-build.yml](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/private-multi-brand-expo-app/dev-build.yml): Private multi-brand app: development builds on EAS internal distribution, one call per brand (call-scope).
- [docs/examples/private-multi-brand-expo-app/store-release.yml](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/private-multi-brand-expo-app/store-release.yml): Private multi-brand app: native-publish per brand (record-scope, EAS credentials, eas-channel baseline) and production EAS Updates in a GitHub Environment.
- [docs/examples/private-multi-brand-expo-app/eas-channel-cleanup.yml](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/private-multi-brand-expo-app/eas-channel-cleanup.yml): Private app: EAS channel cleanup on PR close and a weekly sweep.
- [docs/examples/swift-xcode-app/ios.yml](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/swift-xcode-app/ios.yml): Pure Swift/Xcode app: swift-ios.yml build, sharded tests and TestFlight.
- [docs/examples/swift-xcode-app/release.yml](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/swift-xcode-app/release.yml): Pure Swift/Xcode app: apple-signing + xcode-archive-upload in a gated release job.
- [docs/examples/rn-packages-monorepo/e2e.yml](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/rn-packages-monorepo/e2e.yml): RN packages monorepo: one Maestro call per platform for every package (per-target flowsDir, buildStrategy, tolerateTestFailures).
- [docs/examples/rn-packages-monorepo/pr-closed.yml](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/examples/rn-packages-monorepo/pr-closed.yml): RN packages monorepo: cancel a closed PR's runs.

## Reusable workflows

- [docs/workflows/ios-maestro.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/ios-maestro.md): `ios-maestro.yml` — iOS Maestro e2e: repacks a published base on Linux, compiles on a Mac only for a new native key; `ios-driver` local or device-cloud; `tolerate-test-failures` quarantine; per-target `flowsDir` / `tolerateTestFailures` / `buildStrategy` and `call-scope` for monorepos.
- [docs/workflows/android-maestro.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/android-maestro.md): `android-maestro.yml` — Android Maestro e2e: `android-driver` avd (default, x86_64 KVM), redroid (linux-aarch64) or device-cloud; per-target `flowsDir` / `tolerateTestFailures` / `buildStrategy` and `call-scope` for monorepos.
- [docs/workflows/seed-native-cache.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/seed-native-cache.md): `seed-native-cache.yml` — The warm-up: builds natively for every native key with no published base and publishes the base binary pull requests repack.
- [docs/workflows/expo-base-plan.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/expo-base-plan.md): `expo-base-plan.yml` — The shared "does this commit have to compile native code?" decision the e2e, screenshot and warm-up workflows call; not called directly.
- [docs/workflows/store-screenshots.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/store-screenshots.md): `store-screenshots.yml` — Store screenshot capture matrix (iOS simulators, Android avd or Redroid), flow-per-scene or deep-link manifest, gated fastlane upload, config-file mode.
- [docs/workflows/native-dev-release.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/native-dev-release.md): `native-dev-release.yml` — Development build per platform to a pruned GitHub Release or EAS internal distribution (`distribution: eas`), built locally or on EAS (`build-location: cloud`); `call-scope` for one call per brand in a run.
- [docs/workflows/native-publish.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/native-publish.md): `native-publish.yml` — Signed store publish (`eas build --local` + `eas submit`): targets matrix, `credentials-source: eas`, `record-scope` per brand, `mode: auto` native-or-OTA decision against the store build record or an EAS channel.
- [docs/workflows/store-release.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/store-release.md): `store-release.yml` — Releases an uploaded build: submits the iOS version for App Review and promotes the Android build between Play tracks (staged rollout); dry run by default, idempotent, optional GitHub Environment gate.
- [docs/workflows/expo-ota-preview.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/expo-ota-preview.md): `expo-ota-preview.yml` — Pull-request OTA preview with a sticky comment: `ota-backend: github-release` (tokenless, public repos, previews only) or `eas` (EAS Update, private repos).
- [docs/workflows/expo-fingerprint-guard.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/expo-fingerprint-guard.md): `expo-fingerprint-guard.yml` — Pull-request gate that fails when a change moves the Expo native runtime fingerprint, overridable with a label.
- [docs/workflows/assert-distinct-fingerprints.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/assert-distinct-fingerprints.md): `assert-distinct-fingerprints.yml` — Release pre-flight: fails when two targets with different app ids share a native key.
- [docs/workflows/eas-channel-cleanup-reusable.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/eas-channel-cleanup-reusable.md): `eas-channel-cleanup-reusable.yml` — Deletes a closed pull request's EAS Update channel and branch and sweeps idle channels; never a protected or eas.json channel.
- [docs/workflows/pr-closed-cleanup-reusable.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/pr-closed-cleanup-reusable.md): `pr-closed-cleanup-reusable.yml` — Cancels a closed pull request's queued/running runs and, opt-in, deletes its GitHub Release OTA previews.
- [docs/workflows/preview-sweep-reusable.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/preview-sweep-reusable.md): `preview-sweep-reusable.yml` — Scheduled, dry-run-by-default sweep of GitHub Release OTA previews of closed pull requests and stale branches.
- [docs/workflows/swift-ios.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/workflows/swift-ios.md): `swift-ios.yml` — Pure Swift/Xcode lane: one compile, sharded simulator tests, affected-test selection, opt-in signed TestFlight publish.

## Guides

- [docs/repack.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/repack.md): How a pull request gets its binary without compiling native code: the native key, the published base binary, the repack, the fingerprint.config.js contract and the required permissions.
- [docs/self-hosted-runners.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/docs/self-hosted-runners.md): Host provisioning: the x86_64 Linux repack and KVM pools, macOS Xcode pools, linux-aarch64 Redroid hosts, the prewarm manifest.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Versioning, third-party pinning, self-references, local and fleet validation.
- [RELEASE.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/RELEASE.md): The exact tag-and-publish procedure for a release.
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting and the self-hosted-runner threat model.
- [scripts/slim-simulator.sh](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/scripts/slim-simulator.sh): Local helper that slims a booted simulator against the bundled profiles/ci.json.

## Actions

- [android-emulator](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/android-emulator/README.md): Starts (mode start) or stops (mode stop) a headless Android emulator for the rest of the job. start installs the SDK packages, fails closed without hardware acceleration, sizes the guest from the container's cgroup limits, optionally holds a host-wide emulator slot, boots the AVD to sys.boot_completed and turns animations off. stop, called with if: always(), kills only this job's emulator processes and releases the slot.
- [app-store-release](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/app-store-release/README.md): Submits an already-uploaded, processed iOS build for App Review through the App Store Connect API with a dependency-free Node script: finds, creates or renames the editable version, attaches the build, sets release type and phased release, submits a review submission. Dry run by default; idempotent.
- [apple-signing](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/apple-signing/README.md): Installs a caller-owned Apple distribution certificate, App Store provisioning profile and App Store Connect API key into a throwaway keychain scoped to one job, asserting the profile's application-identifier before any archive runs.
- [apply-secret-env](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/apply-secret-env/README.md): Parses a secret's newline-separated KEY=VALUE entries, masks every value with ::add-mask:: before anything else can print it, and exports them to the job through $GITHUB_ENV with a random delimiter no value can collide with.
- [asc-dedupe-screenshots](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/asc-dedupe-screenshots/README.md): Reads every screenshot of an App Store Connect app version (default: the editable PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION version) via the App Store Connect API - self-signed ES256 JWT, curl+jq+openssl only - groups each localization's screenshot sets by file name, and deletes all but the oldest copy of every duplicate. fastlane's deliver sometimes double-uploads a screenshot when its post-upload verification retries a fresh upload it believes is missing; both copies survive on App Store Connect and the listing shows the same image twice.
- [assert-distinct-fingerprints](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/assert-distinct-fingerprints/README.md): Fails closed when two targets of one platform with different appId resolve to the same native key, naming both targets, the key and the fingerprint sources they share.
- [build-android-app](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/build-android-app/README.md): Sets up a pinned Android SDK cmdline-tools version and builds a Release APK via gradlew, verifying the embedded JS bundle and packaging the result.
- [build-ios-app](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/build-ios-app/README.md): Builds a Release, ad-hoc-signed (entitlements preserved) iOS Simulator .app with an embedded jsbundle via xcodebuild, restoring/saving a CocoaPods cache around `pod install`.
- [capture-screenshots-android](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/capture-screenshots-android/README.md): Drives an already-booted Android device (Redroid container, AVD, or physical) over adb to capture one screenshot per locale x appearance x scene from a JSON scene manifest into a fixed raw/android/<device-slug>/<locale>/<appearance>/<scene>.png layout for store screenshot pipelines.
- [capture-screenshots-ios](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/capture-screenshots-ios/README.md): Boots a pinned iOS Simulator, installs a packaged .app, and captures one screenshot per locale x appearance x scene into a fixed raw/ios/<device-slug>/<locale>/<appearance>/<scene>.png layout for store screenshot pipelines.
- [compose-media](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/compose-media/README.md): Frame raw device captures in fastlane frameit's real device frames and encode web media - framed PNGs for a store set, AVIF + WebP stills, or WebM (AV1/VP9) + H.264 MP4 + WebP poster clips - each file held to a byte budget, failing closed on any missing tool, bad input, or overrun.
- [eas-channel-fingerprint](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/eas-channel-fingerprint/README.md): Decides whether this commit can ship as an OTA on an EAS Update channel: resolves each target's runtime version with ota-runtime-version (the project's own expo-updates, under its eas.json build profile env) and compares it with the latest finished build on the channel and, unless baseline is build, the latest update on every branch the channel serves. decision=ota only when every target matches; an EAS query that fails, or a channel with nothing on it, decides native.
- [eas-profile-env](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/eas-profile-env/README.md): Resolves eas.json build profiles the way EAS does, following each `extends` chain: the merged `env` (child wins), the `channel` and the EAS `environment`.
- [eas-update](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/eas-update/README.md): Publishes an EAS Update with `eas update --json --non-interactive` to a channel (creating it, or pointing a new one at the branch, when auto-create-channel allows), evaluating the app config under an eas.json build profile's env and EAS environment.
- [expo-base-binary](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/expo-base-binary/README.md): Fetches or publishes the base binary a repack starts from, addressed by the native key alone.
- [expo-native-key](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/expo-native-key/README.md): Computes the one key a published base binary is stored under: the platform's @expo/fingerprint hash under the consumer's build env, folded together with the hash of the mobile-ci build action that produced the base, the pinned toolchain identity, and the hash of the fingerprint ignore config.
- [expo-ota-manifest](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/expo-ota-manifest/README.md): Generates an Expo Updates protocol v1 manifest per platform from an existing `expo export` output directory, so the bundle can be served by any static host (GitHub Pages, a self-hosted file server) with no EAS Update and no EXPO_TOKEN. Hashes every referenced file (base64url SHA-256) and emits the launch asset + assets array the `expo-updates` client expects.
- [expo-repack](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/expo-repack/README.md): Turns a published base binary into this build's binary without compiling native code: `@expo/repack-app --embed-bundle-assets` re-bundles the JavaScript with the repository's own Metro and Hermes, swaps the bundle and assets into the simulator `.app` or the APK, and rewrites the embedded Expo config with this build's values.
- [github-release-publish](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/github-release-publish/README.md): Publishes a directory to a GitHub Release under a tag, flattening nested paths to `__`-joined asset names so every file gets an immutable download URL. This is the same channel the native development .ipa/.apk uses.
- [load-consumer-config](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/load-consumer-config/README.md): Read a consumer-owned JSON config file from the checked-out repository and validate it against an allowlist of keys, emitting the compact object for a reusable workflow to resolve its inputs against.
- [native-app-cache](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/native-app-cache/README.md): Restores or saves the canonical native .app/.apk shell keyed on <profile>-<os>-<arch>-<toolchain>-<fingerprint>. A restore hit means the native build can be skipped entirely (the "repack" cache); JS-only changes never invalidate it.
- [native-fingerprint](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/native-fingerprint/README.md): Computes a tokenless native-surface fingerprint with @expo/fingerprint (no EAS account, no EXPO_TOKEN) for use as a native app cache key.
- [node-pm-cache](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/node-pm-cache/README.md): Restores the package manager's download store on every event and exposes the path and key for the calling workflow's own bounded, best-effort `actions/cache/save` step, which runs only off pull requests.
- [ota-runtime-version](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/ota-runtime-version/README.md): Resolves the runtime version an OTA must target with the project's own expo-updates (`npx --no-install expo-updates runtimeversion:resolve`), the value `eas update` and the expo-updates client compute, for every runtime policy.
- [play-store-release](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/play-store-release/README.md): Promotes an already-uploaded Android build from one Google Play track to another through the Play Developer API edits flow with a dependency-free Node script: highest version code on the source track, release notes copied, completed or staged rollout. Dry run by default; idempotent.
- [pr-preview-comment](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/pr-preview-comment/README.md): Keeps one sticky pull-request comment, found by a hidden marker, and replaces only the sections this caller owns, so several workflows (the OTA preview, the native development builds) share one comment without clobbering each other.
- [redroid-container](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/redroid-container/README.md): Starts (mode start) or tears down (mode teardown) a run-scoped Redroid (Android-in-a-privileged-container) instance over the binder_linux kernel module, with prewarm-manifest support and a kernel-assigned loopback adb port.
- [run-maestro-android](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/run-maestro-android/README.md): Boots a headless Android emulator, installs a packaged .apk, runs a Maestro flow shard, and always captures final-state artifacts.
- [run-maestro-android-redroid](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/run-maestro-android-redroid/README.md): Boots a prewarmed or cold-started Redroid (Android-in-a-privileged-container) instance over the binder_linux kernel module, installs a packaged .apk, runs a Maestro flow shard, and always captures final-state artifacts.
- [run-maestro-device-cloud](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/run-maestro-device-cloud/README.md): Runs a Maestro flow selection on hosted devices at devicecloud.dev instead of a simulator or emulator the runner boots itself, so the test job needs only a plain Linux runner with Node.
- [run-maestro-ios](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/run-maestro-ios/README.md): Boots an iOS Simulator, installs a packaged .app, runs a Maestro flow shard, and always captures final-state artifacts on failure.
- [runs-on-cache-bypass](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/runs-on-cache-bypass/README.md): Opt-in.
- [setup-ccache-ios](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/setup-ccache-ios/README.md): Installs and configures a bounded, compressed ccache for iOS xcodebuild invocations, restoring or saving a layered cache keyed on the caller's inputs.
- [setup-xcode-pinned](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/setup-xcode-pinned/README.md): Selects a pre-installed Xcode toolchain by exact version and build number, hard-asserting the match before any build step runs.
- [simulator-lease](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/simulator-lease/README.md): Leases an isolated iOS Simulator for one job — creates a run-scoped device of the requested device type and runtime, boots it, waits for `simctl bootstatus -b`, and records the lease in a file so the paired `mode: release` call shuts the device down and deletes it.
- [swift-test](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/swift-test/README.md): Runs a Swift Package's test suite with `swift test --parallel`, caching the package's `.build` directory on the same toolchain+fingerprint key scheme xcode-cache uses, and publishes a pass/fail step summary.
- [turbo-affected](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/turbo-affected/README.md): Detects whether any of a set of target packages is affected relative to a base SHA, using a pinned `turbo` version. Fails closed: a detection failure is never reported as an unaffected/skip result.
- [xcode-archive-upload](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/xcode-archive-upload/README.md): Archives a scheme for generic iOS with manual signing, then exports it — either straight to App Store Connect with an API key, or to a local export directory when upload is disabled.
- [xcode-cache](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/xcode-cache/README.md): Restores or saves an Xcode build cache triple — DerivedData, the resolved Swift Package clones, and the Xcode 26 compilation cache (CAS) — keyed on the pinned toolchain plus a project fingerprint, and emits the xcodebuild arguments that point Xcode at all three.
- [xcodebuild-affected-tests](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/xcodebuild-affected-tests/README.md): Turns a pull request's changed files into the `only-testing` list that covers them, using a committed path-to-test map, so a PR runs the affected tests instead of the whole suite.
- [xcodebuild-test](https://github.com/rnw-community/mobile-ci/blob/main/actions/xcodebuild-test/README.md): Compiles a scheme's tests once with `build-for-testing`, then runs them with `test-without-building` against an already-booted simulator, optionally sharded across jobs, uploading the .xcresult bundle and publishing a pass/fail step summary.
